prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: small old town cobblestones: many small rounded grey and grey-brown stones (each only about 5-8 art pixels across, packed tightly) in dark thin mortar, worn smooth tops, a few mossy gaps, like a busy harbour street. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map. The ENTIRE image is a tightly packed field of many small rounded old-town cobblestones, grey and grey-brown, each approximately 5–8 ART PIXELS across, in thin dark mortar, with worn smooth tops and a sparse few mossy gaps, evocative of a busy harbour street. Target an underlying 256x256 art-pixel grid magnified uniformly around 7–8 display pixels per art pixel. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, hand-placed crisp square pixels, all pixels identical scale throughout, nearest-neighbour edges, NO anti-aliasing, blur, soft brushwork, photographic texture, random pixel noise, or checkerboard dithering. Use deliberate clear 3–10-pixel color clusters, 4–6 shades per material, rich earthy hues; shadow hues subtly more saturated purple/red, highlights subtly warm yellow. Orthographic overhead top-down RPG-map viewpoint; neutral soft even upper-left ambient light as on a calm overcast evening, clean base color, no cast shadows, night effects, localized illumination, glow, or vignette. Mandatory seamless repeat: stones and mortar crossing the left edge continue exactly from right edge, and top edge continues exactly from bottom edge, without visible seams. Even distribution of small detail, surface fills square edge-to-edge: no framing, borders, objects, people, writing, or focal features.
